```{=html}
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Syne:wght@400;600;700&display=swap');

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --ocean-deep: #08131d;
  --ocean-mid: #0d1f2b;
  --teal: #7ecce6;
  --teal-dim: rgba(126,204,230,0.18);
  --teal-border: rgba(126,204,230,0.20);
  --teal-hover: rgba(126,204,230,0.30);
  --text-primary: rgba(222,238,246,0.95);
  --text-secondary: rgba(190,220,235,0.70);
  --text-muted: rgba(160,200,220,0.50);
  --gold: #f5c865;
  --gold-dim: rgba(245,200,101,0.15);
}

body {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ocean-deep) 0%, var(--ocean-mid) 100%) !important;
  font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif !important;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

h1, h2, h3, p, li { color: rgba(222,238,246,0.92); }

/* ── STATS BANNER ── */
.stats-banner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1px;
  background: var(--teal-border);
  border: 1px solid var(--teal-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}

.stat-cell {
  background: rgba(8,19,29,0.85);
  padding: 1.2rem 1rem;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.stat-cell::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 40%; height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--teal), transparent);
}

.stat-num {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  color: var(--teal);
  line-height: 1;
  display: block;
}

.stat-label {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  display: block;
}

/* ── FILTER BAR ── */
.filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.filter-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-right: 0.25rem;
}

.filter-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--teal-border);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.18s ease;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

.filter-btn:hover { border-color: var(--teal); color: var(--teal); }

.filter-btn.active {
  background: var(--teal-dim);
  border-color: var(--teal);
  color: var(--teal);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.search-wrap { margin-left: auto; position: relative; }

.search-input {
  background: rgba(15,35,53,0.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--teal-border);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 5px 14px 5px 32px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  width: 200px;
  transition: border-color 0.18s;
  outline: none;
}

.search-input:focus { border-color: var(--teal); }
.search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }

.search-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ── SECTION ── */
.section { margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}

.section-title {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-style: italic;
  color: #fff !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.section-line {
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal-border), transparent);
}

.section-count {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ── PUB CARDS ── */
.pub-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--teal-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(12,24,36,0.55);
  padding: 1.1rem 1.3rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pub-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--teal);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
  border-radius: 3px 0 0 3px;
}

.pub-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--teal-hover);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  background: rgba(15,31,47,0.75);
}

.pub-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

.pub-card-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.pub-title {
  font-size: 0.97rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #fff !important;
  line-height: 1.45;
  flex: 1;
}

.pub-expand-icon {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}

.pub-card.open .pub-expand-icon { transform: rotate(180deg); }

.pub-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
}

.pub-authors {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
}

.pub-authors strong { color: var(--teal); font-weight: 500; }

.pub-venue {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-style: italic;
}

.pub-details {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 0.9rem;
  padding-top: 0.9rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--teal-border);
}

.pub-card.open .pub-details { display: block; }

.pub-links { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.pub-link {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--teal-dim);
  border: 1px solid var(--teal-border);
  color: var(--teal) !important;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: all 0.18s;
  font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
}

.pub-link:hover {
  background: var(--teal-hover);
  border-color: var(--teal);
}

/* ── BADGES ── */
.badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 2px 9px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.badge-review {
  background: var(--gold-dim);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245,200,101,0.30);
  color: var(--gold);
}

.badge-prep {
  background: var(--teal-dim);
  border: 1px solid var(--teal-border);
  color: var(--teal);
}

.badge-published {
  background: rgba(80,200,120,0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(80,200,120,0.25);
  color: #7ecfa0;
}

.badge-software {
  background: rgba(160,130,230,0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(160,130,230,0.25);
  color: #b8a4e8;
}

.empty-msg {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  padding: 2rem 0;
  font-style: italic;
}

.hidden { display: none !important; }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .stats-banner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); }
  .search-wrap { margin-left: 0; width: 100%; }
  .search-input { width: 100%; }
}
</style>

<div id="emptyMsg" class="empty-msg hidden">No publications match your search.</div>

<script>
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.pub-card');
  const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  let activeFilter = 'all';

  cards.forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => card.classList.toggle('open'));
  });

  function applyFilters() {
    const q = searchInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    let visibleCounts = { published: 0, review: 0, prep: 0, software: 0 };
    cards.forEach(card => {
      const cat = card.dataset.category;
      const text = (card.dataset.text + ' ' + card.innerText).toLowerCase();
      const show = (activeFilter === 'all' || cat === activeFilter) && (!q || text.includes(q));
      card.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visibleCounts[cat] = (visibleCounts[cat] || 0) + 1;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(sec => {
      const sType = sec.dataset.section;
      const filterMatch = activeFilter === 'all' || activeFilter === sType;
      const hasVisible = visibleCounts[sType] > 0;
      sec.classList.toggle('hidden', !filterMatch || !hasVisible);
      const countEl = document.getElementById('count-' + sType);
      if (countEl) {
        const n = visibleCounts[sType] || 0;
        countEl.textContent = n + (n === 1 ? ' work' : ' works');
      }
    });
    document.getElementById('emptyMsg').classList.toggle('hidden', Object.values(visibleCounts).some(v => v > 0));
  }

  filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      activeFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
      applyFilters();
    });
  });

  searchInput.addEventListener('input', applyFilters);
</script>
```
